newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end 1.85 pct up on IMF loan.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end 1.85 pct up on IMF loan.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended higher on Thursday after the IMF agreed to a medium-term loan facility of at least a $1.6 billion for Pakistan, dealers said.
"The sentiment is likely to remain strong but we can expect a technical correction on Friday," dealer Hasan Dawar at UBS Securities said.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index surged 36.12 points, or 1.85 percent, to close at 1,985.25 at 0908 GMT. Losers led gainers 141 to 87.
PTCL (A) rose 1.70 rupees to 43.80 and ICI Pakistan 1.25 to 34.20. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
